source.title: Glimmering Powder — original Piratica Evercore Shade experience
source.author: Piratica

quote: I made about 700-900 of these to get ~150 catch-up points for each one.
notes: NEW quantitative context within existing 2026-10-31 Piratica CONDITION source, not a new independent study. Author says they leveled 10 new Enchanters using approximately 700-900 crafted Evercore Shade (244752) for approximately 150 catch-up points for each; phrasing does not unambiguously assign 700-900 crafts per character versus pooled crafting, and completed/disenchanted casts are NOT provided. A distinct anecdote says 15-30 Evercore Shade disenchants for six *weekly prerequisite* knowledge drops, sometimes 20 consecutive misses followed by 3-4 hits; those six weekly drops MUST NOT be relabeled as Glimmering Powder. Character skill, exact item-level/bonus, log counts, eligible-versus-ineligible attempts, weekly-cap state, date/patch and material outputs missing. This adds input itemID 244752 and original rough quantities absent the existing conditional record, but provides NO usable per-cast yield, gold EV or zero-inclusive cohort. Item ID independently catalogued on Wowhead PTR 12.1.7; author does not prove PTR/live item-level variant.
